endpoint: Obtain a class-quotient relation lattice for the exact frozen first twenty E302 half ideals without computing the unit/regulator layer.
inputs: The completed first-20 target list, E302 equation/S/maximal order, and generic M17 arithmetic. Public points, M24 and point-dependent selection history are excluded.
method: Run PARI bnfinit(...,0) on the fixed field. From its selected-prime class coordinates construct both R={e in Z^20: sum e_i[P_i]=0} and T={e in Z^20: 2 sum e_i[P_i]=0}; use HNF/SNF-kernel coordinates and LLL bases. First exact-principalize each nonzero-parity short vector from R as a principal multiplier, without calling it a Kummer class. Then exact-principalize J(e)^2 for each nonzero-parity short vector from T; only those square-ideal identities enter strict local correction and generic-character exclusion. Rank candidates by support, exponent size, and generator size rather than accepting the first one.
failure_semantics: No BNF return is UNKNOWN. A class-only BNF is at most a quotient-coordinate guide; every reported relation and every square-ideal candidate is replayed exactly. A direct principal relation with odd valuation at a selected good prime is a multiplier, not an unramified Kummer representative. A miss among LLL bases does not close either full lattice. A strict class is not a rational point until post-hoc M24 exclusion and a witness-hidden cover solve are complete.
